What are you actually booking?

That changes what matters: bedroom count, living space, kitchen equipment, parking, outside space and how the property works for a group are more important than whether there is a hotel bar downstairs.

What Check before paying

First, make sure the accommodation type actually suits your party. A cheap room is no bargain if you needed a kitchen, and a huge holiday house is pointless for two people unless the deal still makes sense. Second, check parking and meal inclusions.
